about: Full Stack Systems Engineer and Co-Founder at SquadCoders, specializing in static-first web architectures, distributed edge computing, and local AI workflows. Proven track record architecting zero-JS Astro static platforms, high-concurrency Cloudflare Worker proxies (Hono, Meta CAPI, Turnstile), and build-time quality verification pipelines. Dedicated to building software that is fast by default (sub-50ms TTFB, 0.00 CLS), zero-waste, and engineered with end-to-end type safety.
